_comment: Import this Egg in Pterodactyl. The Mikan 2.0 release must publish signed standalone node assets before this Egg can start successfully.
name: Mikan 2.0 Node
author: m0ruy0
description: Runs the Mikan 2.0 node binary as an unprivileged Pterodactyl server. Requires outbound HTTPS, OpenSSL, Python 3 and provider-allocated client TCP/UDP ports. No root or Docker socket is used inside the server container.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -e
mkdir -p /mnt/server
cat > /mnt/server/start.sh <<'MIKAN_START'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -Eeuo pipefail
cd /home/container

: "${MIKAN_NODE_JOIN:?Set MIKAN_NODE_JOIN to the one-time key shown by Mikan → Nodes → Add node}"
: "${SERVER_PORT:?Pterodactyl primary allocation is required}"
: "${MIKAN_RELEASE_MANIFEST_URL:?Missing signed release manifest URL}"
: "${MIKAN_RELEASE_PUBLIC_KEY_B64:?Missing trusted Mikan 2.0 public key}"

case "$(uname -m)" in
  x86_64|amd64) arch="x86_64" ;;
  aarch64|arm64) arch="aarch64" ;;
  *) echo "Unsupported architecture: $(uname -m)" >&2; exit 1 ;;
esac

for tool in curl openssl python3 sha256sum base64; do
  command -v "$tool" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "Required tool missing from container: $tool" >&2; exit 1; }
done

mkdir -p /home/container/data /home/container/run
work="$(mktemp -d /home/container/.mikan-bootstrap.XXXXXX)"
trap 'rm -rf "$work"' EXIT

curl -fsSL --retry 3 "$MIKAN_RELEASE_MANIFEST_URL" -o "$work/manifest.json"
curl -fsSL --retry 3 "${MIKAN_RELEASE_MANIFEST_URL}.sig" -o "$work/manifest.json.sig"

{
  printf '%s\n' '-----BEGIN PUBLIC KEY-----'
  printf '%s\n' "$MIKAN_RELEASE_PUBLIC_KEY_B64" | fold -w 64
  printf '%s\n' '-----END PUBLIC KEY-----'
} > "$work/release-public.pem"
base64 -d "$work/manifest.json.sig" > "$work/manifest.sig"
if ! openssl pkeyutl -verify -pubin -inkey "$work/release-public.pem" -rawin -in "$work/manifest.json" -sigfile "$work/manifest.sig" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "The Mikan 2.0 release manifest signature is invalid; refusing to start." >&2
  exit 1
fi

python3 - "$work/manifest.json" "$arch" > "$work/node-info" <<'PY'
import json, re, sys
manifest = json.load(open(sys.argv[1], encoding="utf-8"))
arch = sys.argv[2]
asset = manifest.get("node", {}).get(arch)
if not isinstance(asset, dict):
    raise SystemExit("This signed release has no standalone node asset for " + arch + ". Publish a Mikan 2.0 release with node assets first.")
url, checksum = asset.get("url", ""), asset.get("sha256", "")
prefix = "https://github.com/m0ruy0/mikan-2.0/releases/download/"
if not url.startswith(prefix):
    raise SystemExit("The node asset URL is outside the Mikan 2.0 release namespace.")
if not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{64}", checksum):
    raise SystemExit("The signed node asset checksum is invalid.")
print(manifest.get("version", ""))
print(url)
print(checksum)
PY
mapfile -t node_info < "$work/node-info"
version="${node_info[0]}"
node_url="${node_info[1]}"
expected_sha="${node_info[2]}"
if [[ -z "$version" || -z "$node_url" || -z "$expected_sha" ]]; then
  echo "The signed manifest did not provide a complete node asset." >&2
  exit 1
fi

installed_sha=""
if [[ -x /home/container/mikan-node ]]; then
  installed_sha="$(sha256sum /home/container/mikan-node | awk '{print $1}')"
fi
if [[ "$installed_sha" != "$expected_sha" ]]; then
  echo "Downloading signed Mikan 2.0 node $version ($arch)..."
  curl -fsSL --retry 3 "$node_url" -o "$work/mikan-node"
  printf '%s  %s\n' "$expected_sha" "$work/mikan-node" | sha256sum --check --status
  install -m 0755 "$work/mikan-node" /home/container/mikan-node.new
  mv -f /home/container/mikan-node.new /home/container/mikan-node
else
  echo "Reusing verified Mikan 2.0 node $version ($arch)."
fi

api_port="$(MIKAN_NODE_JOIN="$MIKAN_NODE_JOIN" /home/container/mikan-node key-port | tr -d '\r\n')"
if [[ ! "$api_port" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]]; then
  echo "Could not read API port from MIKAN_NODE_JOIN." >&2
  exit 1
fi
if [[ "$api_port" != "$SERVER_PORT" ]]; then
  echo "Port mismatch: the key expects API port $api_port, but Pterodactyl's primary allocation is $SERVER_PORT." >&2
  echo "Re-create the node key in Mikan with API port $SERVER_PORT, or change the server allocation to match." >&2
  exit 1
fi

export MIKAN_DATA_DIR=/home/container/data
export MIKAN_NODE_SOCKET=/home/container/run/node.sock
export MIKAN_NODE_API_LISTEN=0.0.0.0
rm -rf "$work"
trap - EXIT
echo "Mikan Pterodactyl node started; signed binary verified. Make sure client inbounds use only allocated TCP/UDP ports."
exec /home/container/mikan-node
MIKAN_START
chmod 755 /mnt/server/start.sh

variables.name: Mikan node join key
variables.description: Paste only the one-time key shown after creating the node in Mikan. Do not paste the full curl command and never share this key.

variables.name: Signed release manifest URL
variables.description: Do not change this unless you operate your own signed Mikan 2.0 release repository.

variables.name: Trusted Mikan 2.0 release public key
variables.description: Ed25519 SubjectPublicKeyInfo encoded as base64; used to verify the signed release manifest.
